name: Baobh
text: Baobh is another spelling of the name Badh. Badh is a figure of battle in early Irish belief, close to the crow or the raven. She haunts the field where men fight. The forms of the name shift across the sources, and Baobh is one of the later spellings of that figure.

attributes.attribute: a variant spelling of the name Badh
a figure of battle like the crow

okr.objective: Record the variant spelling Baobh of the battle figure.
key_results: Set the figure on the battlefield.
